title: Design and Evaluation of Epira: An Automated Interview System for Case Investigation and Contact Tracing
abstract: arXiv:2611.25577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective: Case investigation and contact tracing are labor-intensive. Web forms struggle when respondents need clarification before disclosing contacts, and open-ended chatbots may deviate from protocols. We developed and evaluated Epira, a protocol-controlled large language model (LLM) interviewer for multi-disease case investigation and contact tracing.   Materials and Methods: Epira pairs LLM dialogue with a rule-based controller enforcing required questions, safety handoffs, and a structured case record, and adapts to new diseases by questionnaire upload. Local (Qwen2.5) and cloud (GPT-5.4) backends were tested. Study 1 used 108 simulated cases with ground-truth fields and contacts for measles and gonorrhea under Epira and open-ended conditions (864 sessions). translated_abstract: 目的：病例调查和接触者追踪是劳动密集型工作。当受访者在透露接触者信息前需要澄清时，网络表格难以应对，而开放式聊天机器人可能偏离工作协议。我们开发并评估了Epira，一种用于多疾病病例调查和接触者追踪的协议控制大语言模型（LLM）访谈系统。材料与方法：Epira将LLM对话与基于规则的控制器相结合，该控制器强制执行必问问题、安全交接和结构化病例记录，并可通过上传问卷适配新疾病。研究测试了本地（Qwen2.5）和云端（GPT-5.4）两种后端。研究1使用108个麻疹和淋病模拟病例（包含真实标准字段和接触者信息），在Epira和开放式条件下进行测试（共864次会话）。研究2招募了72名志愿者，采用2×2疾病-模型访谈设计，评估完成度、可用性、可接受性和信任度。结果：在研究1中，使用……的Epira（摘要截断）
tldr: Epira是一种将大语言模型对话与规则控制器相结合的协议控制自动化访谈系统，既能灵活应对受访者澄清需求，又能严格遵循流调协议，为多疾病病例调查和接触者追踪提供了有效的自动化解决方案。
